title: Missteps Mount in Justice Dept.’s Case Against Minnesota Anti-ICE Protesters
summary: The problems plaguing the case have not only hurt the government’s chances, lawyers say, but have also undermined the bonds of trust that prosecutors have traditionally enjoyed in court.
